concept.title: Meeting people after moving to a new area
concept.shortdesc: As someone who has just moved to a city where I know few people, I need ways to meet others through shared activities, so that I can build a social routine.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-020). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Sociable and fit but has not rebuilt his social routine.
A good result: A range of social groups and activities by interest, with how to join and whether newcomers are welcome.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: how to meet people in a new city
clubs and societies to make friends
community groups near me for adults

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
